poin.isi: Cohere launched North 2 (Oct 5), an enterprise agent platform. Agents now keep memory across sessions, can be reused across teams, and their spend can be capped per person and per agent.
The three things that used to be a trade-off — secure, smart, or controllable — now come together. North 2 runs in the cloud, on your own servers, or fully air-gapped.
Healthy agent adoption is about control: start with a clear task, cap the cost from day one, and keep approval for important decisions in human hands.

headline: AI AGENTS NOW COME WITH
BUDGETS, PERMISSIONS, MEMORY
headline_caption: Cohere North 2: enterprise AI agents with spending caps, permissions, and cross-session memory.
subjudul: Cohere North 2 (Oct 5): per-agent spending caps, cross-session memory, runs on your own servers.
